name: app-light-and-dark-floating-tab-bar-on-green-blur
title: Light and Dark Floating Tab Bar
whatItIs: Two versions of a pill navigation bar (Home, Insight, AI Assistant, Activity, Profile) on blurred green backgrounds, one white and one charcoal, with a pointer cursor over the active tab.
whatItMeans: Showing light and dark side by side proves theme flexibility, and the blurred foliage tones keep it soft and natural.
techniques: Pill container with the active tab as an inner pill
Thin monoline icons with short labels
Blurred green photograph as ambient backdrop
Mirrored light and dark variants stacked

vocabulary.definition: A highlighted rounded shape behind the selected tab.
Light and dark variants of a component shown together.
An out-of-focus photo used as a color backdrop.
